metadata.title: DocuVault — Your Documents, Safe. Found in Seconds.
metadata.description: Built-in document scanner, AI summarization and natural-language search. All your critical documents in one encrypted vault. For iOS. Turkish and English.
metadata.ogTitle: DocuVault — Your Documents, Safe. Found in Seconds.
metadata.ogDescription: Built-in scanner, AI summarization and natural-language search — all your documents in one encrypted vault. For iOS.
metadata.twDescription: Built-in scanner, AI summary and natural-language search. Encrypted document vault for iOS.

hero.subtitle: Digitize instantly with the built-in scanner. AI summarizes, natural language finds, AES-256 protects — all in one app.

features.subtitle: Security, speed and intelligence — combined in a single app. Every detail designed with the discipline of a master archivist.

scanner.title: Built-in Document Scanner
scanner.body: Automatic edge detection, multi-page PDF stitching and skew correction. No third-party app required.

aiSummary.title: AI Executive Summary
aiSummary.body: Meaningful summary, critical points and recommendations for every document you upload. Get the gist in 30 seconds instead of hours of reading.

naturalLanguage.title: Natural-Language AI Search
naturalLanguage.body: Type "last month's electricity bill" — AI interprets your query, weighing content and document attributes together.

voice.title: Voice Command
voice.body: Voice search in Turkish and English. Reach your documents hands-free, with a single spoken command.

smartNaming.title: Smart Naming
smartNaming.body: AI reads the content and files it as "Electricity Bill — March 2026" instead of "IMG_4519", sorting it into the right one of 8 built-in categories.

collections.title: Custom Collections
collections.body: Home, work, health — unlimited collections with your own icon and color. Find related documents at a single glance.

howItWorks.title: Document chaos ends in five steps.
howItWorks.subtitle: Scan, organize, summarize, find and store securely. DocuVault handles the rest.

scan.title: Scan or Upload
scan.body: Open the built-in scanner and frame the page — automatic edge detection, multi-page PDF and skew correction happen in the background. Gallery, camera and file upload are all supported.

organize.title: AI Organizes
organize.body: AI reads the content, saves it under a meaningful name (e.g. "Electricity Bill — March 2026") and assigns it to the right one of 8 built-in categories.

summary.title: Read the Executive Summary
summary.body: On the document detail screen, AI gives you the summary, critical points and recommendations within seconds. The gist in 30 seconds, not hours of scanning.

find.title: Find with Natural Language
find.body: Type or speak — for natural queries like "last month's electricity bill", AI weighs both content and document attributes.

secure.title: Store Securely
secure.body: AES-256 local encryption, TLS 1.2+ transport, Face ID/Touch ID lock and encrypted cloud backup. Only you have access.

pricing.title: A plan that fits you.
pricing.subtitle: Start free, upgrade as your needs grow. Cancel anytime.
pricing.footnote: Approximate USD prices shown; final charge may differ slightly with App Store conversion. Subscription is charged to your Apple ID on confirmation. Manage subscriptions through the App Store.

security.title: Your privacy is sacred to us.
security.subtitle: Your documents are among the most private parts of your life. We treat them that way.

encryption.title: AES-256 + TLS 1.2+
encryption.body: AES-256 symmetric encryption in the local archive. All transport over TLS 1.2+. Industry standard, non-negotiable.

residency.title: EU Data Residency
residency.body: Encrypted cloud stored on industry-leading Supabase + AWS infrastructure at EU-based endpoints. The DocuVault team has no access to your content.

biometric.title: Face ID + Backup PIN
biometric.body: Biometric authentication, backup PIN and automatic lock when the app moves to the background. No ad SDKs, no IDFA identifier.

support.title: Need a hand?
support.subtitle: We're here for your questions, feedback or technical issues. Happy to help.

fast.title: Quick Response
fast.body: Send your questions by email. We get back to you as soon as possible.

email.title: Email Support
email.body: Write to us for technical issues, account matters or product feedback.

finalCta.title: End document chaos today.
finalCta.subtitle: Download DocuVault for free. Set up your vault in minutes and store your documents securely.
